sections.title: 1. Introduction & Module Overview
sections.intro:
The Mall Management module manages the shops and tenants of the hotel's attached mall/commercial complex — lease agreements, monthly utility billing (electricity/water meter reading), service charges.

MALL FLOW: Register shops (Shop Master) → Lease agreement (tenant, rent, deposit, terms) → Daily meter reading (electricity/water) → Monthly bill generation (rent + utilities + service charges) → Collection tracking.

rows: Shop Master, Charge Master, Unit Type, Lease Agreement, Facility Sundry, Tenant Location
Service Bill Entry, Daily Meter Reading

subsections.title: Key Benefits
bullets: Shop-wise tenant ledger — rent, deposit, dues
Meter reading based utility billing — no disputes
Lease renewal reminders via agreement expiry

subsections.title: 2.1 Shop Master
subsections.navPath: Main Setup ▶ Mall Management ▶ Shop Master
subsections.paragraph: Register all mall shops/shop units — shop no., floor, area (sqft), type. The lease agreement attaches to this shop. Facility charges (CAM) are defined in the Charge Master, shop units in Unit Type, tenant mapping in Tenant Location.

subsections.title: 2.2 Lease Agreement Entry
subsections.navPath: Main Setup ▶ Mall Management ▶ Lease Agreement
subsections.paragraph: Tenant's lease record — agreement no., tenant details, monthly rent, escalation %, security deposit, lease start/end dates, CAM charges. Renewal follow-up on expiry.

subsections.title: 3.1 Daily Meter Reading
subsections.navPath: Mall Management ▶ Operation ▶ Daily Meter Reading
subsections.paragraph: By entering the reading of electricity/water meters of every shop daily/monthly — consumption units are calculated from the previous reading. Billing is based on these readings.

rows: How many units, at what rate

subsections.title: 3.2 Service Bill Entry
subsections.navPath: Mall Management ▶ Operation ▶ Service Bill Entry
subsections.paragraph: Tenant's monthly bill — rent + meter consumption + CAM/service charges + GST. Bill is printed, posted in tenant ledger. Payment is settled upon receipt.
steps: By selecting Shop/tenant — load lease details
When payment is received, make the settlement entry
